descriptionEnglish: Charcoal burners and smelters who hold the hill kilns above Emberfall. They pay well, they pay on time, and they never explain what the ore is for.
The families who keep the weir and the fish ladders. They were here before the kilns and they intend to be here after.

A downriver concern that has bought every ounce the Guild can burn, for four years, at a price nobody wants to examine. It has no hall and no banner in Emberfall — only a factor, a room at the inn, and a barge that comes at night.
